paragraphs: R' Chiyya son of Maryah, Sanhedrin, chapter 1, halakhah 2; R' Yochanan son of Maryah, Terumot, chapter 11, halakhah 1.[^1]

notes.text: פ״א ה״ב and פי״א ה״א give Sanhedrin chapter 1 halakhah 2 and Terumot chapter 11 halakhah 1. Jerusalem Talmud is suggested by format but not stated or independently checked. The two attestations do not establish a single father Maryah; both body title abbreviations remain R'.
